ruled_numbers.RR_DEFAULT_THREADS_ENV: unset (engine default — what a user gets)

arming.film_choice_reason: first measured manifest row (deterministic; what --n 1 sends) AND the film whose frames are proven byte-identical A==B==C across the engine argv / LI pipe / LI file paths — committed probe_frame_parity artifact — so the same-frames precondition is strongest exactly here
arming.score_treatment: gate 3 compares SORTED LABEL MULTISETS only (gates_shared.py:842-843); scores are consulted solely on frames whose labels already diverge, as 6-decimal-rounded multisets for the boundary exclusion — sub-1e-6 cross-arm score differences are invisible to the verdict by design

near_threshold_census.note: H16 drift cap (0.5%/video) is LIVE and UNSIZED for films — this census is the film's measured exposure

liveness.derivation: RULING R: 0.5 x min(per-arm non-empty-frame fraction) measured on the staged film by the leg driver's own records — the measured minimum with a stated 2x margin. Single-film basis DISCLOSED; never a Corner-derived number on films content.

disclosures: DISCLOSURES: char_conservation verdict at the Phase-1 +/-2 pct default is band-cutting DATA for the films band (Ruling L equivalence note), not a calibrated headline; the gate-3 boundary-exclusion drift cap (0.5 pct/video) is LIVE and UNSIZED for films content (H16 open — do not read its verdict as calibrated).
